upload.limitation: Vercel v6 tree wraps prebuilt uploads in src/ and may omit lengths; complete path/SHA1 identities are verified, with lengths checked when exposed. This is upload identity, not CDN byte enumeration.

http.limitation: All known-file HTTP checks plus upload identity. No claim of internal CDN filesystem enumeration. Transport compression is decoded by fetch; content mutation is rejected.

trustBoundary: Vercel authenticated API upload identity and prebuilt semantics; SHA1 is provider upload identity, SHA256 protects local bytes. CDN internals and generated metadata are trusted, not fully remotely enumerated.
